meta.basis: Colours and typefaces from the Eirlys AI design spec (2026-10-21). Everything else follows tasteskill v2 app-screen rules, style framed-sheet with --keep palette,type.
meta.ladder: Spacing is the app ladder (4px base). The Eirlys marketing ladder (8px base) is not used in the groomer app.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The frame: page ground behind the sheet, sidebar and top bar. Carries the pearl image (assets/pearl.png) when the page is large enough.

tokens.name: pearl-lilac
tokens.usage: One of the three pale fields in the pearl ground image. Identity colour; never used directly on UI.

tokens.name: pearl-cyan
tokens.usage: The second pearl field. Identity colour; never used directly on UI.

tokens.name: pearl-pink
tokens.usage: The third pearl field. Identity colour; never used directly on UI.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The work surface inset in the frame. Replaces pure white; nothing on the screen is #fff.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: A panel one step off the sheet: a selected row's band, a quiet secondary button, the empty-state box.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: The active nav item's pill and a pressed control. Same value as ground, by design: one step, reused.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The sheet's 1px edge and card edges, about 1.25:1 on sheet: a whisper, never a grid of boxes. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Row rules inside tables and lists, one step lighter than border (about 1.15:1 on sheet).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and outlined buttons, one step darker than border so a control reads as a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 11.7:1 on ground, 13:1 on sheet. Replaces pure black.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, meta, placeholders. 5.6:1 on ground; the lightest grey allowed for words.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: the primary button, the selected state, the focus ring, the main data element. Under 5% of any screen.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every control.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Translucent sheet colour under a sticky bar or a sheet-level overlay.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Text colour of the pending status: a booking the agent held and the groomer has not decided. The screen's most important signal.

tokens.name: pending-bg
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind pending text.

tokens.name: confirmed
tokens.usage: Text colour of the confirmed status. 5.2:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: confirmed-bg
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind confirmed text.

tokens.name: declined
tokens.usage: Text colour of declined and cancelled, and form errors. Same as the Eirlys error colour.

tokens.name: declined-bg
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind declined text.

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Pill fill for neutral tags (channel, service, size tier); text in ink.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: The main series: today's bookings, the selected week, the booked bars.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: A second series when the screen must compare two things. Never a third hue without a reason.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: A third series, rarely. Kept out of the orange range.

families.sans: "Figtree Variable", "Figtree", "Noto Sans SC Variable", "Noto Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Sheet inset from the window; gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding; gap between stacked controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on the phone; gap between a heading and its first row.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and the canvas gutter on desktop; gap between cards. One gutter for every row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Control height; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top bar height; table row height.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Labelled sidebar width on desktop; folds on the phone.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height. No rule between it and the sidebar.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of inputs, selects and buttons.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Table and list row height.

tokens.name: sheet-inset
tokens.usage: The sheet's distance from the window's right and bottom edges.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The sheet's corners.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on the sheet.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the active nav item.
